root.label: Massachusetts DPU approves Algonquin gas agreements

events.label: Massachusetts DPU approves Algonquin gas agreements

slots.name: approved agreements
slots.sentence: In January, the Massachusetts Department of Public Utilities (DPU) approved two 10-year agreements between units of New England energy company Eversource Energy (ES.N) and Algonquin to deliver new gas supplies to customers.
